subject: Fwd: Gen II Boston - Drinks order
body:
Hi Rachel -- please see the email below, can you make these modifications
to the proposal curated for Gen II Fund earlier today?

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Natalia Diaz <office@example.com>
Date: Tue, Sep 29, 2026 at 2:36 PM
Subject: RE: Gen II Boston - Drinks order
To: Sean Fitzgibbons <sean@getbevvi.com>


Hi Sean,



Thank you for sending the attached document. Please remove the following
items from the order:



- Cantena Malbec

- Pilsener Urquell (12 pk Bottles)

- Octoberfest Bottles

- Spaten Oktoberfest Ur-Marzen Bottles

- Redhook ESB Bottles

- Founders All Day IPA (I only need 1 case)



Additionally, please remove all beer in bottles, as we cannot have that in
the office. Once you make these adjustments, could you please resend me an
updated quote? I’ll need it for payment submission.



Best,

Natalia

Hi Natalia,

Got it, I've updated the order to include the cases of Allagash White.



Most items on your list is included. A few items aren't carried by the
store that serves your address, so the team has recommended the closest
match instead (marked * in the PDF):


Please see attached and as always, we are happy to modify in any fashion
needed!



Cheers,
Sean

Best,
Sean

Hi Sean,



I hope you were not affected by the storm. Please find attached this
month's order. Note that everything must be in cans.



Ideally, we would like the delivery by Thursday. If that’s not possible,
please ensure it arrives by next Monday at the latest.



Best,

Natalia
